fixes.why: Mistranslation: the name means the whole army charges, not an 'all-out' charge; also aligns with the sister SP attack u0747 'All-Forces Full Salvo' (same term).

fixes.en:
An elite U.N. Forces officer serving as chief combat controller of the
Macross air wing. A by-the-book stickler whom Hikaru treated as an
"old lady", she gradually comes to love him. (CV: Mika Doi)
fixes.why: Wrong referent: the dangling modifier made Hikaru the by-the-book stickler; the source describes Misa.
